teacherPlayback: Two complete playbacks controlled by the teacher. No student media controls.
scoreRule: 6 objectively scored multiple-choice tasks and 2 teacher-reviewed written tasks, 1 point each. Proposed grade only after both written tasks reviewed.
notes: Contains hostile dialogue and profanity. Require age-appropriate teacher supervision and direct recording check.

objective.q: What contradiction characterises the main speaker's behaviour?
options: He wants peace but speaks aggressively
He praises the guests but asks them to leave
He encourages the men to interrupt him
He cancels the wedding to prevent conflict
objective.explanation: His demands for restraint are delivered as angry threats.

objective.q: Why do the repeated interruptions matter to the scene?
options: They prove the men accept all the rules
They reveal that nobody knows whose wedding this is
They weaken his attempt to maintain control
They make the wedding speech more formal
objective.explanation: Other speakers interfere with his authority.
objective.sourceEvidence: The men interject during his warnings.

objective.q: What does the objection about uniforms imply?
options: All guests are soldiers
There is hostility between groups attending the event
The speaker has asked everyone to wear matching clothes
The men are planning to join the army
objective.explanation: The uniforms serve as a reminder of existing tension.
objective.sourceEvidence: A man protests that there would be no uniforms.

objective.q: Why does referring to Grace strengthen the order?
options: It shows she has agreed to the prohibitions
It suggests the speaker has forgotten his own wishes
It makes the speaker's threats less serious
It presents obedience as protecting another person's dignity
objective.explanation: He frames behaviour in terms of avoiding embarrassment for Grace.
objective.sourceEvidence: He demands the men not embarrass the bride.

objective.q: What does the unexpected question about 'snow' add to the scene?
options: It creates a comic contrast with the intimidating warning
It explains the location of the ceremony
It ends the tension permanently
It clarifies which men have uniforms
objective.explanation: An incongruous remark interrupts an aggressive scene.
objective.sourceEvidence: The snow question prompts further refusals.

objective.q: What is the effect of repeating the last instruction?
options: It makes everyone agree to the conditions
It moves the discussion to a different issue
It intensifies pressure and exposes frustration
It signals the speaker is joking about fighting
objective.explanation: His louder repetition increases intimidation while suggesting uncertainty.
objective.sourceEvidence: He repeats and shouts the closing order.

written.q: Assess whether the speaker's way of talking is likely to prevent trouble. Use one moment from the scene.
written.modelAnswer: His threats might gain obedience, but the anger and interruptions can also intensify conflict.
written.teacherCriterion: One supported judgement on whether threats are effective, with a scene detail.
written.sourceEvidence: The speaker seeks peace while using aggression.

written.q: Choose one comic interruption and explain its effect beyond simply being funny.
written.modelAnswer: The snow question undercuts a solemn warning and shows how difficult it is for the speaker to control the group.
written.teacherCriterion: One identifiable interruption and a plausible dramatic effect.
